name: Mchango payment-SMS samples
note: Every sample is made up: test numbers 2557000009xx, demo names, invented transaction IDs and amounts. Only the structure, spacing and punctuation follow real messages. 'expect.ok' true = a payment coming in that the app may offer to record; false = the app must refuse it and say why.

samples.note: three spaces before the time, and no space in '.Salio'
samples.text: QK7XM2PAR4 Imethibitishwa. Umelipwa Tsh100,000.00 kutoka kwa 255700000901 - ZAWADI TUMAINI AMANI mnamo 17/9/26   2:14 PM.Salio lako jipya ni Tsh369,101.00.

samples.note: a payer on another network gives the same shape, with their own number
samples.text: QM3RD8XKT5 Imethibitishwa. Umelipwa Tsh500.00 kutoka kwa 255700000902 - FURAHA AMANI mnamo 30/9/26 6:16 PM. Salio lako jipya ni Tsh369,601.00.

samples.note: four spaces before the time, then '5:55 PM.Salio'
samples.text: TK9AB1CD2E Imethibitishwa. Umelipwa Tsh500.00 kutoka kwa 255700000903 - UPENDO FARAJA mnamo 9/11/26    5:55 PM.Salio lako jipya ni Tsh1,000.00.

samples.note: 1:30 AM on 1/10/26 in East Africa Time is 1 October, not 30 September
samples.text: TL1MN2OP3Q Imethibitishwa. Umelipwa Tsh1,000.00 kutoka kwa 255700000904 - AMANI TUMAINI mnamo 1/10/26 1:30 AM. Salio lako jipya ni Tsh2,000.00.

samples.note: 12:15 AM is a quarter past midnight
samples.text: TM2NO3PQ4R Imethibitishwa. Umelipwa Tsh1,000.00 kutoka kwa 255700000905 - FARAJA ZAWADI mnamo 2/10/26 12:15 AM. Salio lako jipya ni Tsh3,000.00.

samples.note: 12:15 PM is a quarter past noon
samples.text: TN3OP4QR5S Imethibitishwa. Umelipwa Tsh1,000.00 kutoka kwa 255700000905 - FARAJA ZAWADI mnamo 2/10/26 12:15 PM. Salio lako jipya ni Tsh4,000.00.

samples.note: money going OUT of a till to a business: never a contribution
samples.text: TP4QR5ST6U Imethibitishwa. Kiasi cha Tsh500.00 kimelipwa kwenda DUKA LA MFANO LTD mnamo 9/11/26 6:02 PM. Salio jipya la Merchant akaunti ni Tsh500.00.

samples.note: an amount with cents is refused, never rounded
samples.text: TQ5RS6TU7V Imethibitishwa. Umelipwa Tsh1,000.50 kutoka kwa 255700000906 - TUMAINI FURAHA mnamo 9/11/26 6:10 PM. Salio lako jipya ni Tsh1,500.50.
TR6ST7UV8W Imethibitishwa. Umelipwa Tsh1,000.00 kutoka kwa 255700000907 - ZAWADI UPENDO mnamo 31/2/26 6:10 PM. Salio lako jipya ni Tsh1,500.00.

samples.note: a personal wallet receiving money, Kiswahili
samples.text: PA1BC2DE3F Imethibitishwa. Umepokea Tsh5,000.00 kutoka kwa 255700000908 - FURAHA ZAWADI mnamo 9/11/26 3:10 PM. Salio lako jipya la M-Pesa ni Tsh12,345.00.

samples.text: PB2CD3EF4G imethibitishwa. Umelipwa Tsh1,000.00 kutoka kwa 255700000909 - AMANI UPENDO mnamo 9/11/26 4:00 PM. Salio lako jipya ni Tsh2,000.00.
